card.name: Fluid and electrolyte replacement wording
card.fires_on: Words right before 'fluid(s)' or 'electrolytes' in diarrhea and dehydration text, such as 'intake of', 'appropriate', 'significant', and the word 'fluid' itself before 'and electrolyte'.

modes.label: Lead-in to fluids
modes.description: A small word or adjective that comes just before 'fluids' or 'electrolytes' in advice on diarrhea care.
modes.example: start treatment with antidiarrheal agents and increase intake<< of>> oral fluids.

modes.label: Fluid before electrolyte
modes.description: The word 'fluid' or part of 'electrolyte' inside the phrase 'fluid and electrolyte' about loss or imbalance.
modes.example: which can cause profound<< fluid>> and electrolyte abnormalities

modes.label: Inside rehydration words
modes.description: Partway through words such as intravenous or rehydration that lead to fluid replacement.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'fluid' and 'electrolyte' next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to mention fluids and electrolytes lost to diarrhea or needing replacement.
